description: Customer payload distribution -> weighted-average TTFT for each serving config. Measured on trn2.48xlarge, TP=32, vLLM-Neuron v5 beta, bf16, on-device greedy sampling.

single_bucket_4k.note: Every prompt padded to 4K; flat cost regardless of input size.

single_bucket_1k.note: Best for short prompts only; the 22.2% of >1K traffic needs a different server.

multi_bucket.note: Each request lands in its smallest fitting bucket. Best overall for variable-length traffic.

headline: Multi-bucket [512,1024,2048,4096] = 172.0 ms weighted-average TTFT (41% faster than single-bucket [4096]'s flat 290 ms) on this customer's distribution.
